jobs.title: Solution Engineer - Integration Platform
jobs.description:
Do you want to shape how development teams across Sandvik build and operate integrations at scale? Join us in creating the platform capabilities, automation and templates that enable secure self-service delivery across the organization.

Some of the things you'll do:

Build reusable capabilities that reduce manual work and enable independence.
Influence the developer experience across APIs, integrations and event-driven solutions.
Collaborate closely with architects, product specialists, and development teams.

Your mission

In this position, you focus on building the tools, templates, and automation that enable development teams to create and operate integrations independently. Experience with end-to-end integration delivery is great to have, although this work centers on reusable platform capabilities rather than individual integrations. Working from vendor-agnostic principles, you turn standards and architectural direction into practical platform capabilities that perform reliably in production. You’re part of the PA Engineering Platforms Integration team and report to the Competence Manager.

Job responsibilities:

Build and maintain our self-service integration builder using reusable platform components, templates and shared services for APIs, integrations and event-driven solutions built on top of Azure Integration Services.
Develop CI/CD pipelines, automation services and utilities that support platform delivery and operations.
Embed security, logging, reliability, quality and compliance controls into pipelines and templates.
Translate architecture and technical standards into consistent, production-ready implementation patterns.
Onboard and support development teams using the platform, improving its capabilities based on their feedback.
Troubleshoot live integrations and take ownership of platform components in production.

Location

This position is based at the World Trade Center in Stockholm or Mossvägen in Sandviken.

Your profile

You’re an experienced engineer with a strong software development foundation and exposure to platform engineering, DevOps and enterprise integration environments. Translating architectural direction and technical standards into reusable solutions comes naturally to you, and you enjoy creating capabilities that other development teams can adopt with confidence.

Your background also includes:

Hands-on production experience with Azure Integration Services, including Logic Apps, Azure Functions, API Management (APIM), and Service Bus or Event Grid.
Strong programming skills in C# or Python, combined with the ability to write and troubleshoot Bash and/or PowerShell scripts.
Experience with integration patterns, including APIs, messaging, event-driven architecture, and API gateways or enterprise integration platforms.
Hands-on experience with CI/CD, deployment automation, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep or similar), and cloud-native environments.
Experience working with distributed systems and container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

Additionally, experience with front-end technologies such as React or Angular, as well as relational and NoSQL databases, is considered an advantage.

With a developer-first mindset, you balance high technical standards with pragmatic decisions that move work forward. You communicate complex topics clearly, collaborate constructively, and take ownership of what you build, while continuously improving the experience for teams using the platform.

Our culture

At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. So, we invest in supporting each other, learning together and celebrating our differences. Visit our stories hub, LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us further.

Contact information

For further information about this position, please contact Mikael Berglund, hiring manager, mikael.b.berglund@sandvik.com

We’ve already decided on which advertising channels and marketing campaigns we wish to use and respectfully decline any additional contacts in that matter.

How To Apply

Send your application no later than October 18, 2026. Click apply and include your resume and cover letter in English. Please note that we don’t accept applications by e-mail. Job ID: R0097991.

To learn more about our recruitment process, please visit our career site or contact HR Services at hrservices.sweden@sandvik.com.

Sandvik is a global, industrial technology group providing solutions that enhance productivity, profitability and sustainability for the manufacturing, mining and infrastructure industries. We are at the forefront of digitalization and focus on optimizing our customers’ processes. Our world-leading offering includes equipment, tools, services and digital solutions for machining, mining, rock excavation and rock processing. In 2025 the Group had approximately 42,000 employees and revenues of about SEK 121 billion in more than 150 countries.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview

Security represents the most critical priorities for our customers in a world awash in digital threats, regulatory scrutiny, and estate complexity. Microsoft Security aspires to make the world a safer place for all. We want to reshape security and empower every user, customer, and developer with a security cloud that protects them with end to end, simplified solutions. The Microsoft Security organization accelerates Microsoft’s mission and bold ambitions to ensure that our company and industry is securing digital technology platforms, devices, and clouds in our customers’ heterogeneous environments, as well as ensuring the security of our own internal estate. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset, a theme of inspiring excellence, and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. In doing so, we create life-changing innovations that impact billions of lives around the world.

As a part of this role, as a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a part of the Identity for Services (ID4S) Team, part of Microsoft Entra. The mission of this team is to make it hard to get authentication and authorization wrong. We believe the tasks to get authentication and authorization right, actively preventing security incidents, and always being updated for a service should be straightforward and at the same time provide operational insights as part of the platform. As a team, we take meaningful steps daily to achieve our mission supporting developers, security operations, and administrators. Our solution is used across thousands of internal Microsoft services, and several of our components are available as open source on GitHub. Our main authentication SDK is written in .NET, and we focus on building robust, extensible APIs that minimize resource usage while maximizing security and resilience. We also embrace AI-powered workflows to accelerate development and improve efficiency. Our team is enthusiastic about exploring new ways to co-create with AI and leverage it for better engineering outcomes. There are still many challenges for us to solve to deliver on our mission, and to help us we are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer who thrives on building seamlessly integrated components running in high-scale services where security, resilience, memory, and performance are daily motivators. You work effectively across a large set of organizations and teams company-wide and operate with a customer-first mindset. As a team, we ensure our solution utilizes minimal resources, scrutinizes allocations, designs APIs to be configuration-driven and extensible, and collects telemetry to provide key insights for effective operations.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

#MSFTSecurity, #OAuth, #Authentication, #Authorization

Responsibilities

Develop and maintain authentication and authorization components for various platforms, including .NET (experience with Rust, Java, Golang, Python, Node.JS is a plus).
Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as leadership teams, product managers, service owners, and platform teams.
Make data-driven decisions using quantitative and qualitative insights.
Support service owners to ensure seamless integration and operational excellence.
Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and contribute to the overall improvement of our authentication libraries.
Explore and apply AI-assisted development practices to improve velocity and quality.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.
experience with Distributed Services

Preffered Qualifications

experience with SDK and/or experience high scale services

Other Requirements

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft background and Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Understanding of authentication and authorization protocols, including OAuth, OpenID Connect, and SAML

Experience with .NET

jobs.title: Snr GMP Software Developer
jobs.description:
Role Overview

We are looking for someone with a strong software engineering background who understands the full development lifecycle — from design and coding through testing, release, and operations — and who can translate that understanding into a DevOps strategy and CI/CD approach that integrates smoothly with how our development teams actually build software.
We are looking for a talented and driven DevOps Lead to define and own our DevOps strategy — the engineering practices, toolchain, and delivery infrastructure that determine how software is built, tested, and released across the organisation. A key initial focus for this role is our Manufacturing Execution System (MES) programme, where you will bridge development, operations, and quality in a regulated manufacturing environment, but the role's remit extends beyond any single platform. Prior exposure to MES platforms such as Syncade is a plus, but not a prerequisite.
Key Responsibilities

Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines that reflect a solid understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), ensuring builds, tests, and deployments integrate smoothly with how engineering teams design, code, and release software — including for MES deployments across development, test, and production environments
Develop, own, and continuously evolve our DevOps strategy — defining the target toolchain, automation approach, and ways of working that align development and operations across the organisation, with the MES programme as an initial priority area.
Work with MES Vendors to define requirements and shape development to align to the DevOps strategy
.
Own the DevOps toolchain — source control, build automation, release management, environment provisioning, monitoring, and observability.
Define and enforce branching strategies, code review processes, and release management standards appropriate to a regulated manufacturing environment.
Work closely with vendors, system integrators, and internal teams to understand platform architecture and translate this into maintainable infrastructure-as-code and deployment automation.
Lead environment management across the software estate — including MES ensuring environments are correctly configured, version-controlled, and fit for purpose across all lifecycle stages.
Implement and maintain monitoring, alerting, and logging solutions to provide operational visibility of MES platform health and performance.
Drive shift-left quality practices — working with the testing team to embed automated testing into pipelines and ensuring quality gates are robust.
Support computer system validation (CSV) activities, maintaining audit trails, deployment records, and change control documentation in compliance with GxP requirements.
Manage infrastructure provisioning supporting workloads, ensuring security, resilience, and scalability.
Identify and resolve bottlenecks in the delivery pipeline, continuously improving deployment frequency, lead time, and recovery metrics (DORA).
Act as a technical authority and escalation point for infrastructure and deployment issues across the MES programme.

Essential Requirements

Software development background — hands-on experience as a software engineer or developer, with a solid grasp of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), coding practices, and application architecture, and the ability to use that experience to shape how DevOps and CI/CD integrate with development teams' ways of working.
Proven experience in a DevOps Lead or Senior DevOps Engineer role on complex enterprise software programmes.
Strong hands-on experience with CI/CD tooling — Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or equivalent.
Solid understanding of infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible) and configuration management practices.
Experience managing environments for large-scale enterprise applications, including environment promotion strategies and configuration management.
Proficiency in scripting languages (PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar) for automation and tooling.
Demonstrated experience defining or evolving a DevOps strategy or roadmap — toolchain selection, automation approach, and ways of working — grounded in a strong understanding of the software delivery lifecycle, release management, and change control in enterprise settings.
Experience working in regulated industries (pharmaceutical, life sciences, or similar) with awareness of compliance and validation requirements.
Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex infrastructure and deployment issues under pressure.

Desirable Requirements

Direct experience deploying, maintaining, or supporting off-the-shelf MES platforms— including configuration, and upgrade activities.
Familiarity with GxP computer system validation (CSV), GAMP 5 lifecycle, and associated documentation requirements (IQ, OQ, PQ).
Knowledge of containerisation technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and their applicability within regulated manufacturing environments.
Understanding of MES integration patterns — ERP (SAP), LIMS, historian, and shop-floor device connectivity.
Experience with security hardening, vulnerability management, and operational security in manufacturing environments.

jobs.title: Associate Technical Services Engineer II
jobs.description:
MongoDB Technical Services Engineers use their exceptional problem solving and customer service skills, along with their deep technical experience, to advise customers and to solve their complex MongoDB problems. Technical Service Engineers are experts in the entire MongoDB ecosystem - database server, drivers, cloud and infrastructure. This also includes services such as Atlas (database as a service), or Cloud Manager (which helps customers with automation, backup and monitoring of their MongoDB systems). Our engineers combine their MongoDB expertise with passion, initiative, teamwork and a great sense of humor to help our customers to be successful with MongoDB.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are interested in working out of our Dublin office under our in-office working model Monday to Friday for the first 3-6 months depending on ramping speed.

Once considered ramped, they will transition to a permanent (Tuesday to Saturday) 9am-6pm work week (with 3 in-office days) to provide weekend coverage alongside other peers. Saturdays and Sundays are considered fully online workdays and not an on-call shift.

Due to the 24/7 nature of our support organization, certain events throughout the year will require volunteering for coverage outside one’s normal work days or work hours (i.e. regional offsites, regional holidays, etc). These are typically announced weeks in advance with a sign-up system that considers equitability.

Cool things you’ll do

You'll be working alongside our largest customers, solving their complex challenges - resolving questions on architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between. You'll be an expert resource on best practices in running MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be. You'll be an advocate for customers' needs - interfacing with our product management and development teams on their behalf. And you'll contribute to internal projects, including software development of support tools for performance, benchmarking, and diagnostics.

What you need

We consider all candidates with an eye for those who are self-taught, insatiably curious, and multi-faceted.

The ideal candidates should have strong technical experience in one (or more) of the following areas

Systems administration
Distributed systems
Network Administration
Database architecture and administration
Application Architecture
Data architecture and design
Performance tuning and benchmarking
Extra bonus points if you have experience in one or more of Java, Python, Ruby, C, C++, C#, Javascript, node.js, Go, PHP, or Perl

If you have an operations background, we prefer experience administering large-scale production environments, including hardware, operating systems (e.g. Linux, Windows), networks (including firewalls and load balancers), as well as cloud-based resources (e.g. AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform).

It’s crucial for every candidate that they can check off all of these boxes

Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
Genuine desire to help people
Uncontrollable urge to investigate and solve problems, with advanced diagnostic and troubleshooting skills
Ability to think on your feet, remain calm under pressure and solve problems in real-time
Desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills
Strong teamwork: willingness and ability to get help from team members when required, and the good judgment to know when to seek help

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.
